title: George W. Bush considered UFO disclosure with Stephen Hadley

tellings.quote: It's now public knowledge through Hal Putoff that George W. Bush contemplated UFO disclosure with his national security adviser Steven Hadley.

plain: During his presidency in the 2000s, George W. Bush thought about making UFO secrets public, a step the field calls disclosure, and discussed it with his national security adviser Stephen Hadley. Michels says this is now public knowledge through the physicist Hal Puthoff, so he is repeating what Puthoff has said rather than anything he saw, and if true it would mean a sitting president believed there was something to disclose.
